porParaExercises.question: La reunión se canceló ___ la lluvia.

porParaExercises.translation: La réunion a été annulée à cause de la pluie.
porParaExercises.translation_en: The meeting was cancelled because of the rain.
porParaExercises.hint: (but, destination, échéance → para ; cause, passage, échange, moyen → por)
porParaExercises.hint_en: (goal, destination, deadline → para; cause, route, exchange, means → por)

porParaExercises.question: Necesito gafas ___ leer.
porParaExercises.translation: J'ai besoin de lunettes pour lire.
porParaExercises.translation_en: I need glasses to read.
porParaExercises.hint: (but, destination, échéance → para ; cause, passage, échange, moyen → por)

porParaExercises.question: Dos ___ dos son cuatro.
porParaExercises.translation: Deux fois deux font quatre.
porParaExercises.translation_en: Two times two is four.
porParaExercises.hint: (but, destination, échéance → para ; cause, passage, échange, moyen → por)
porParaExercises.hint_en: (goal, destination, deadline → para; cause, route, exchange, means → por)

porParaExercises.question: Me quedé en casa ___ cuidar a mi madre.
porParaExercises.question_en: Me quedé en casa ___ cuidar a mi madre.
porParaExercises.translation: Je suis resté à la maison pour m'occuper de ma mère.
porParaExercises.translation_en: I stayed at home to look after my mother.
porParaExercises.hint: (but, destination, échéance → para ; cause, passage, échange, moyen → por)
porParaExercises.hint_en: (goal, destination, deadline → para; cause, route, exchange, means → por)

porParaExercises.question: Lo vendió ___ poco dinero.
porParaExercises.translation: Il l'a vendu pour peu d'argent.
porParaExercises.translation_en: He sold it for very little money.
porParaExercises.hint: (but, destination, échéance → para ; cause, passage, échange, moyen → por)
porParaExercises.hint_en: (goal, destination, deadline → para; cause, route, exchange, means → por)

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Me caí delante de todos y estaba muy ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Me caí delante de todos y estaba muy ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je suis tombée devant tout le monde et j'étais très gênée.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I fell in front of everyone and I was very embarrassed.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: avergonzada = gênée. embarazada = enceinte !
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: avergonzada = embarrassed. embarazada = pregnant!

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Tengo fiebre y estoy ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Tengo fiebre y estoy ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: J'ai de la fièvre et je suis enrhumé.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I have a fever and a cold.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: constipado = enrhumé. Constipé se dit estreñido.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: constipado = having a cold. Constipated is estreñido.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: No como fibra y estoy ___ desde hace tres días.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: No como fibra y estoy ___ desde hace tres días.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je ne mange pas de fibres et je suis constipé depuis trois jours.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I don't eat fibre and I've been constipated for three days.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Constipé = estreñido. constipado veut dire enrhumé.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Constipated = estreñido. constipado means having a cold.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: La película fue un gran ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: La película fue un gran ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Le film a été un grand succès.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The film was a big hit.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Le succès = el éxito. un suceso = un fait divers, un événement.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Success = el éxito. un suceso = an incident, a news item.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Perdone, busco ___: ¿está al fondo?
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Perdone, busco ___: ¿está al fondo?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Pardon, je cherche la sortie : elle est au fond ?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Excuse me, I'm looking for the exit: is it at the back?
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: La sortie = la salida. el éxito = le succès (piège pour l'anglais exit).
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: The exit = la salida. el éxito = success, not exit.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Pedí el libro prestado en la ___ municipal.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Pedí el libro prestado en la ___ municipal.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: J'ai emprunté le livre à la bibliothèque municipale.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I borrowed the book from the public library.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Bibliothèque = biblioteca. librería = librairie, où l'on achète.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Library = biblioteca. librería = bookshop, where you buy.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Compré una novela en la ___ de la esquina.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Compré una novela en la ___ de la esquina.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: J'ai acheté un roman à la librairie du coin.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I bought a novel at the bookshop on the corner.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: librería = librairie. On y achète ; à la biblioteca, on emprunte.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: librería = bookshop. You buy there; at the biblioteca you borrow.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Hay una ___ persa en el salón.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Hay una ___ persa en el salón.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Il y a un tapis persan dans le salon.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: There's a Persian rug in the living room.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Un tapis = una alfombra. una carpeta = une chemise, un dossier.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A rug = una alfombra. una carpeta = a folder.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Guarda los documentos en esta ___ azul.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Guarda los documentos en esta ___ azul.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Range les documents dans cette chemise bleue.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Put the documents in this blue folder.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: carpeta = chemise (de bureau), dossier. Pas une carpette !
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: carpeta = folder. Not a carpet!

falsosAmigosExercises.question: El río es muy ___: mide quinientos kilómetros.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: El río es muy ___: mide quinientos kilómetros.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Le fleuve est très long : il mesure cinq cents kilomètres.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The river is very long: it's five hundred kilometres.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: largo = long. Large se dit ancho.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: largo = long, not large. Wide is ancho.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: La calle es muy ___: caben cuatro coches uno al lado de otro.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: La calle es muy ___: caben cuatro coches uno al lado de otro.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: La rue est très large : quatre voitures y tiennent côte à côte.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The street is very wide: four cars fit side by side.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Large = ancho. largo veut dire long.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Wide = ancho. largo means long.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Le escribí hace una semana y todavía no me ha ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Le escribí hace una semana y todavía no me ha ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je lui ai écrit il y a une semaine et il ne m'a toujours pas répondu.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I wrote to him a week ago and he still hasn't answered me.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: contestar = répondre. Contester se dit protestar ou impugnar.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: contestar = to answer, not to contest.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Para la boda, Ana se compró ___ de seda.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Para la boda, Ana se compró ___ de seda.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Pour le mariage, Ana s'est acheté une robe en soie.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: For the wedding, Ana bought herself a silk dress.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Une robe = un vestido. la ropa = les vêtements en général.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A dress = un vestido. la ropa = clothes in general.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Mis ___ viven en Lyon: mi madre y mi padre.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Mis ___ viven en Lyon: mi madre y mi padre.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Mes parents vivent à Lyon : ma mère et mon père.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: My parents live in Lyon: my mother and my father.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Les parents (père et mère) = los padres. los parientes = la famille élargie.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Parents = los padres. los parientes = relatives.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Ella ___ su trabajo el año pasado.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Ella ___ su trabajo el año pasado.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Elle a quitté son travail l'an dernier.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: She left her job last year.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Quitter = dejar (ou salir de). quitar = enlever.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: To leave = dejar. quitar = to take off, remove.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: ___ los zapatos antes de entrar.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: ___ los zapatos antes de entrar.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Enlève tes chaussures avant d'entrer.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Take your shoes off before coming in.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: quitar = enlever. quitarse los zapatos = enlever ses chaussures.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: quitar = to remove. quitarse los zapatos = to take your shoes off.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: La enfermera ___ a los pacientes con mucha paciencia.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: La enfermera ___ a los pacientes con mucha paciencia.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: L'infirmière s'occupe des patients avec beaucoup de patience.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The nurse looks after the patients very patiently.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: atender = s'occuper de, servir. Attendre se dit esperar.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: atender = to look after, to serve. To wait is esperar.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Te ___ en la parada del autobús.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Te ___ en la parada del autobús.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je t'attends à l'arrêt de bus.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I'll wait for you at the bus stop.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Attendre = esperar. atender = s'occuper de.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: To wait = esperar. atender = to attend to.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: La empresa ___ grandes pérdidas.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: La empresa ___ grandes pérdidas.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: L'entreprise a subi de grosses pertes.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The company suffered heavy losses.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Subir (au sens de supporter) = sufrir. subir = monter.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: To suffer = sufrir. subir = to go up.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: ___ al tercer piso por la escalera.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: ___ al tercer piso por la escalera.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je suis monté au troisième étage par l'escalier.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I went up to the third floor by the stairs.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Monter (un escalier, un étage) = subir. montar = monter à cheval, assembler.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: To go up = subir. montar = to ride, to assemble.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Me cuesta ___ lo que siento.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Me cuesta ___ lo que siento.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: J'ai du mal à exprimer ce que je ressens.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I find it hard to express what I feel.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Exprimer = expresar. exprimir = presser (un fruit).
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: To express = expresar. exprimir = to squeeze.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: ___ un limón sobre el pescado.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: ___ un limón sobre el pescado.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Presse un citron sur le poisson.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Squeeze a lemon over the fish.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: exprimir = presser un fruit. Exprimer, c'est expresar.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: exprimir = to squeeze. To express is expresar.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Pon las flores en el ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Pon las flores en el ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Mets les fleurs dans le vase.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Put the flowers in the vase.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Un vase = un florero (ou un jarrón). un vaso = un verre.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A vase = un florero. un vaso = a glass.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: ¿Cuál es tu ___ de teléfono?
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: ¿Cuál es tu ___ de teléfono?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Quel est ton numéro de téléphone ?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: What's your phone number?
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Un nombre, un numéro = un número. el nombre = le nom, le prénom.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A number = un número. el nombre = the name.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: El semáforo está en ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: El semáforo está en ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Le feu est au rouge.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: The traffic light is red.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Rouge = rojo. rubio = blond.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Red = rojo. rubio = blond.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: ¿Puedo pagar con ___?
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: ¿Puedo pagar con ___?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je peux payer par carte ?
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Can I pay by card?
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Une carte (bancaire, de visite) = una tarjeta. una carta = une lettre, ou le menu.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A card = una tarjeta. una carta = a letter, or the menu.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Me escribió una ___ de amor.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Me escribió una ___ de amor.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Il m'a écrit une lettre d'amour.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: He wrote me a love letter.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Une lettre = una carta.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A letter = una carta.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Mi padre cobra la ___ desde 2020.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Mi padre cobra la ___ desde 2020.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Mon père touche sa retraite depuis 2020.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: My father has been drawing his pension since 2020.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: La retraite (du travail) = la jubilación. una retirada = un retrait, un repli.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: Retirement, pension = la jubilación. una retirada = a withdrawal.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Viven en una ___ con vacas y gallinas.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Viven en una ___ con vacas y gallinas.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Ils vivent dans une ferme avec des vaches et des poules.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: They live on a farm with cows and hens.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Une ferme = una granja. una firma = une signature.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A farm = una granja. una firma = a signature.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Hace frío: ponte el ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Hace frío: ponte el ___.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Il fait froid : mets ton manteau.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: It's cold: put your coat on.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Un manteau = un abrigo. un mantel = une nappe.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: A coat = un abrigo. un mantel = a tablecloth.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Pon el ___ en la mesa antes de comer.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Pon el ___ en la mesa antes de comer.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Mets la nappe sur la table avant de manger.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: Put the tablecloth on the table before eating.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: mantel = nappe. Pas un manteau !
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: mantel = tablecloth.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: Me duele la ___ derecha.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: Me duele la ___ derecha.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: J'ai mal à la jambe droite.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: My right leg hurts.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: La jambe = la pierna. una gamba = une crevette.
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation_en: The leg = la pierna. una gamba = a prawn.

falsosAmigosExercises.question: No te ___: habla más alto.
falsosAmigosExercises.question_en: No te ___: habla más alto.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation: Je ne t'entends pas : parle plus fort.
falsosAmigosExercises.translation_en: I can't hear you: speak louder.
falsosAmigosExercises.hint: (le mot qui ressemble au français est souvent le piège)
falsosAmigosExercises.hint_en: (the word that looks familiar is often the trap)
falsosAmigosExercises.explanation: Entendre = oír. entender = comprendre.
